representation: exact final-affine input, verified against native logits
historical_neural_input_normalizer: all uncapped source-session trials from historical TRAIN subjects
role_sessions: both physical sessions for each subject role; historical checkpoint selection used future session only
primary_standardizer: one StandardScaler fitted on all TRAIN_GEOMETRY trial embeddings, both sessions
low_dimension_gate: all three real-vs-label-null 5/95 percentile criteria in >=4/5 folds
unseen_geometry_gate: coverage and cosine above 95th-percentile random basis in >=4/5 folds; shared BA >=0.55 and >=full BA-0.05 in >=4/5 folds
private_utility_gate: subject-equal private rescue >=0.10 and stacked BA gain >=0.005 in >=3/5 folds or positive NLL gain in >=4/5 folds
stacker: two-margin LogisticRegression fitted on subject-grouped TRAIN OOF predictions, with OOF scaler/basis/base decoders refitted excluding each OOF subject
outer_policy: evaluation metrics and evaluation-only local decision normals; never scaling, basis, rank, decoder, fusion or threshold fit
